purpose: Reads one record for a record card, from the page's cache when the list already has it and from its own vault otherwise, and knows which vault holds it.
namedChanges: The imports of `readRecord` and `BaseRecord` (`./records`), `recordsKey`, `flattenRecordPages`, `isTempId` and `RecordsPage` (the same file, now `record-cache-kit`) and `vaultOriginOf` (`./config`) are imports of the units `lws-records`, `record-cache-kit` and `vault-origin-rule`.

The comments that name a cycle, a ticket, an agent, a person, a ruling or a host are reworded with the same facts; no code changed. The comment-stripped file, imports excluded, equals the source's lines 2696-2961 (0 diff).

Not taken, because the units on main already hold them: `freshlyCreatedIds` and its window (`plan-record-hooks`, which since 0.2.1 also exports `consumeFreshlyCreated` and `clearFreshlyCreated`), `recordsKey`, `RECORD_QUERY_HEAD`, `flattenRecordPages`, `RecordsPage`, `isTempId` and `setRecordReads` (`record-cache-kit`). Not taken, because the held card does not read it: `useSelectRecordFromCache`.
